memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Vitamin D deficiency.
Patient reports fatigue and mild aching in shoulders over past month. No bone deformities, tenderness mild over ribs. Smoking status: never. Planned labs: serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D, calcium, phosphate. Started high‑dose cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then reassess.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 20‑50).
Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.8 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Vitamin D deficiency, improving.
Patient feels less fatigued, mild shoulder ache resolved. Adherent to weekly high‑dose inhaler‑free regimen. Smoking status: never. Plan: check labs, switch to maintenance cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 18 ng/mL (ref 20‑50).
Serum calcium: 9.3 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.9 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Vitamin D deficiency, partially corrected.
Patient reports occasional low‑energy evenings, no bone pain. Smoking status: never. Labs show sub‑optimal level; increase maintenance to cholecalciferol 2000 IU daily to achieve target >30 ng/mL.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 24 ng/mL (ref 20‑50).
Serum calcium: 9.4 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 4.0 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Vitamin D deficiency, now sufficient.
Patient feels energetic, no musculoskeletal complaints. Smoking status: never. Labs within target range; reduce to maintenance cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 32 ng/mL (ref 20‑50).
Serum calcium: 9.3 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.9 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up pulmonology review for 2026-05-20 at 10:00 am.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Vitamin D deficiency, maintained.
Patient reports continued well‑being, no symptoms. Smoking status: never. Labs stable; continue cholecalciferol 1000 IU daily and review in 6 months.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Serum 25‑hydroxyvitamin D: 30 ng/mL (ref 20‑50).
Serum calcium: 9.2 mg/dL (ref 8.5‑10.5).
Serum phosphate: 3.8 mg/dL (ref 2.5‑4.5).
